关于旅行计划的故事(A Story about the travel plan): 一篇关于旅行出行的A2短文:艾米与米娅的经历和小计划。
It takes twenty minutes to get to the travel plan by bike. There are always many people at the bus stop. Amy usually has soup for breakfast. What's more, stay in the right lane while driving.
Amy wants to be a cook in the future. The weather was rainy that day. Amy hopes to visit Sydney one day. The letter was addressed to Messrs Smith and Sons.
Amy learned a lot about math. Amy drinks milk after doing sports. Amy and Mia had great fun there. Best of all, kids drew pictures on the sidewalk.
Mia is interested in reading. They took many photos at the bus stop. Life is full of small surprises.
